== Description ==

[[Patrick Johnson]] (facing the camera, grey T-shirt) playing [[Greg Shaw]] (right), with [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (left, black Mariners cap and black hoodie) watching at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; remaining faces unlabeled.
